operator_verbatim_statement: OPERATOR [L3] S3 VERDICT RATIFICATION | I ratify the governing scientific verdict for batteryml-protocol-robustness-s3 as MODEL_SPECIFIC. | Under the preregistered sample of 64 minimum-cost protocol-disjoint primary83 partitions, Ridge exhibited material positive RMSE change with high prevalence. Variance and XGBoost did not cross the preregistered material-prevalence threshold (p_abs < 0.50). | This result supports a model-specific robustness/generalization sensitivity finding for the pinned BatteryML MATR1 benchmark. It does not establish universal degradation, data leakage, misconduct, a pure causal protocol effect, or direct applicability to field BESS/Battery Passport performance. | The preregistered dummy composition-sensitivity flag was not activated, but composition effects are not ruled out. | I ratify the governing evidence package at Git commit 9a0ad9c and authorize transition of the study from GOVERNING_EXECUTION_COMPLETE_PENDING_RATIFICATION to RATIFIED / CLOSED. | Final public wording remains subject to the final text gate.
